vocabulary.meaning_en: careful study to find out new facts
vocabulary.note_en: Say do research, not make research.
vocabulary.example: We need to do some research before we start.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of questions asked to many customers to learn their opinions
vocabulary.example: We sent a customer survey to 200 shops.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a written list of questions
vocabulary.example: Please fill in this short questionnaire.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what someone thinks about something
vocabulary.example: Could I ask for your opinion?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to create and improve a new product
vocabulary.example: We are hoping to develop a new product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: now; at the present time
vocabulary.example: What products do you currently use?

vocabulary.meaning_en: at a time after now
vocabulary.example: What would you like us to sell in the future?

vocabulary.meaning_en: one specific thing
vocabulary.example: Any particular product you would like to see?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start selling a new product; the start of selling it
vocabulary.example: We will launch the product in spring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: other companies that sell similar things
vocabulary.example: Check out the competition first.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the money needed to make or do something
vocabulary.example: Work out the costs before you decide.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to calculate or find the answer
vocabulary.example: Can you work out the total cost?

vocabulary.meaning_en: phoning people you don't know to sell or ask questions
vocabulary.meaning_ar: الاتصال بعملاء محتملين دون موعد مسبق
vocabulary.example: I need to do some cold calling again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list or book of companies and their contact details
vocabulary.example: Look them up in the business directory.

vocabulary.meaning_en: people who already buy from you
vocabulary.example: Call our existing customers first.

vocabulary.meaning_en: people you know who can help you in business
vocabulary.example: Tom has loads of contacts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: organised information stored on a computer
vocabulary.example: I put all the information in a database.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give some of your time
vocabulary.example: Can you spare a few minutes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of different products a company sells
vocabulary.example: It would be a great addition to their range.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something added
vocabulary.example: This product is a great addition to our range.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when people don't understand each other
vocabulary.example: I think there might be some confusion here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wanting to do something; interested
vocabulary.example: Tom doesn't seem so keen.

fine_lines.title: survey vs questionnaire
fine_lines.explanation_ar: survey هو الدراسة أو عملية جمع الآراء من أشخاص كثيرين. questionnaire هو قائمة الأسئلة نفسها المستخدمة في هذه الدراسة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A survey is the whole study of people's opinions. A questionnaire is the list of questions used in it.

examples.sentence: We did a customer survey last month.

fine_lines.title: currently vs actually
fine_lines.explanation_ar: currently تعني (حاليًا / الآن). أما actually فتعني (في الواقع / في الحقيقة) وليست (حاليًا)، وهذا خطأ شائع عند المتعلمين العرب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Currently means now. Actually means 'in fact', not 'now' – a common mistake.

examples.sentence: What products do you currently use?

expressions.phrase: Could I ask for your opinion on a new product we are hoping to develop?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني أن أسألك عن رأيك في منتج جديد نأمل في تطويره؟
expressions.example: Could I ask for your opinion on a new product we are hoping to develop?

expressions.phrase: What plastic products do you currently use?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما المنتجات البلاستيكية التي تستخدمونها حاليًا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about what customers use now.
expressions.example: What office products do you currently use?

expressions.phrase: What products would you like to see us sell in the future?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما المنتجات التي تودّون أن نبيعها في المستقبل؟
expressions.example: What products would you like to see us sell in the future?

expressions.phrase: How do you feel about the idea of selling plastic vegetables?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما شعورك تجاه فكرة بيع خضراوات بلاستيكية؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for an opinion on a new idea.
expressions.example: How do you feel about the idea of opening on Saturdays?

expressions.phrase: Any particular vegetable you would like to see?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل هناك نوع معيّن من الخضراوات تودّ أن تراه؟
expressions.example: Any particular colour you would like to see?

expressions.phrase: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تخصّص بضع دقائق لمساعدتي؟
expressions.example: Hello, can you spare a few minutes to help me with a short survey?

expressions.phrase: I'll be as quick as I can.
expressions.meaning_en: Promising not to take much time.
expressions.example: Thank you. I'll be as quick as I can.

expressions.meaning_ar: شكرًا على وقتك على أي حال.
expressions.meaning_en: Ending a call politely, even if it didn't help.
expressions.example: Sorry, you're not the right company. Thanks for your time anyway.

grammar.title: Would like + to + verb / would like + object + to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: would like تعبير مهذب بمعنى (يودّ). نقول would like to + الفعل، أو would like + شخص + to + الفعل: What would you like us to sell? ومع see نقول would like to see us sell (بعد see يأتي الفعل بدون to).
grammar.explanation_en: 'Would like' is a polite way to say want: would like to + verb, or would like + person + to + verb: What would you like us to sell? After 'see us' use the base verb: like to see us sell.
examples: What products would you like us to make?
What would you like to see us sell in the future?
I would like to ask you a few questions.

grammar.title: How do you feel about + noun / verb-ing?
grammar.explanation_ar: لسؤال شخص عن رأيه نقول How do you feel about + اسم أو فعل مع ing: How do you feel about the idea of selling…?
grammar.explanation_en: To ask for an opinion use 'How do you feel about + noun / -ing?'
examples: How do you feel about the idea of selling plastic vegetables?
How do you feel about working on Saturdays?
How do you feel about the new design?

grammar.title: Present continuous for plans: we are hoping to…
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر للتحدث عن خطط ومشاريع جارية: a new product we are hoping to develop، we're trying to develop.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present continuous for ongoing plans and projects: a product we are hoping to develop.
examples: We are hoping to develop a new product.
We're trying to get some opinions.
I'm doing some research this week.

questions.question: How does Anna politely start her research call?
choices: Could I ask for your opinion on a new product we are hoping to develop?
questions.explanation_ar: هذه طريقة مهذبة لبدء مكالمة بحثية.
questions.explanation_en: This is a polite way to start a research call.

questions.question: Complete: 'What plastic products do you ___ use?'
Complete: 'How do you feel about the idea of ___ plastic vegetables?'
questions.explanation_ar: بعد of نستخدم الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: What would you like that we sell?
What would you like us sell?
What would you like us to sell?
What would you like us selling to?

questions.question: What is a questionnaire?
questions.explanation_en: A questionnaire is a list of questions.

questions.question: 'Existing customers' are…
choices: people who already buy from you
people who have never heard of you

questions.question: What did the first company Anna called sell?
questions.explanation_ar: كانت الشركة تبيع ألعابًا بلاستيكية للقطط.
questions.explanation_en: They sold plastic toys for cats.

questions.question: Complete: 'Can you ___ a few minutes to help me?'
questions.explanation_ar: spare a few minutes: تخصيص بضع دقائق.
questions.explanation_en: 'Spare a few minutes' means give some time.

questions.question: The narrator's advice: before a survey, you should check…
choices: what type of business you are calling
questions.explanation_ar: النصيحة: تأكد من نوع الشركة قبل إجراء الاستبيان.
questions.explanation_en: Check what type of business you are calling.
